name: Orbit AI - Phase 1 - E-sign completed to Onboarding

nodes.name: Documenso webhook
nodes.notes: Configured as this workflow's URL in Documenso's own webhook settings (Documenso -> Settings -> Webhooks), with the shared secret set there checked in the IF node below.

nodes.name: Is DOCUMENT_COMPLETED?
nodes.notes: Documenso fires webhooks for other document lifecycle events too (created, sent, viewed, rejected, etc.) - this workflow only cares about the fully-signed one. Event name per Documenso's own webhook docs; not verified against a real Documenso instance from this sandbox. This node does not verify the X-Documenso-Secret header - add that check before going live (Documenso signs every webhook request with the shared secret configured at setup).

nodes.name: Advance CRM to Onboarding
nodes.notes: Assumes the Documenso document was created with its 'externalId' set to the Twenty CRM Opportunity ID at send-time (so this webhook can find its way back to the right record) - that link-up step isn't built anywhere in this repo yet (it belongs to W1.3, Proposal delivery, documented-only in workflows/README.md). Same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty flagged on the other Phase 1 workflows.

nodes.name: Send Onboarding Form email (Plunk)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $json.body.payload.document.recipients[0].email, subject: 'Next step: your Onboarding Form', body: 'PLACEHOLDER_ONBOARDING_FORM_EMAIL_BODY - insert the real onboarding form link/copy once the portal (Netlify-hosted, per the brief) exists.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Plunk's send endpoint/body shape per their public API docs (checked via web search from this sandbox, not tested against a real Plunk account). Host is documented in two forms across Plunk's own docs (api.useplunk.com vs next-api.useplunk.com) - confirm which is current before relying on this. Email body is a named placeholder, not real copy - the Onboarding Form itself isn't built in this repo (W1.5, documented-only).
